subject: Staged MAP & Purchase Playbook — TerraNova (GCP private offer)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@terranova.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Sep 2029 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Staged MAP & Purchase Playbook — TerraNova (GCP private offer)

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — following up with a first draft of a mutual action plan (MAP) and recommended evaluation cadence for the GCP private offer path. Attached is a compact MAP workbook (TerraNova_MAP_v1.xlsx) and an acceptance checklist we use for Private Offers (Acceptance_Checklist_Redwood.pdf). High-level proposal below: 

- Evaluation: 2 week PoC (engineering sandbox + 3 key prompts, perf/latency targets) — owner: TerraNova engineering; SE support: Jonas.
- Technical acceptance (TA): sign-off from TerraNova SRE + Redwood solutions engineer within 1 week after PoC.
- Procurement / Private Offer: start parallel to PoC week 2; expect 2–4 week procurement window depending on PO approvals and legal redlines.
- Billing path options: GCP private offer (preferred) — settlement via marketplace or direct invoicing depending on your finance preference; Kimberley (cc) leads billing guidance.
- Go-live target: 6 weeks from kick-off if no major legal/technical blockers.

Can you confirm (a) the procurement owner and finance contact, and (b) whether TerraNova prefers an invoice to your PO or Marketplace settlement for the private offer? If helpful I can kick off a short procurement sync with our finance and marketplace billing lead next week.

Proposed next step: procurement + technical kickoff on Tuesday 9/17 at 10am PT — quick 30m to align owners and dependencies. Please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: TerraNova_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), Acceptance_Checklist_Redwood.pdf (TA checklist)

Thanks Irene — this looks like a great starting point. A few quick notes: 

1) Procurement owner: Brian Cole (cc) — he'll drive the PO & legal.
2) Finance contact: Gina Walsh (we'll loop her on the invoice preference).
3) Marketplace vs. PO: our procurement team prefers PO/direct invoice where possible to route to our internal ERP, but we understand private offers via GCP marketplace sometimes require settlement on the marketplace account. Could you/your billing lead confirm what the practical choices will be and if Redwood can support direct invoicing on a private offer?

Brian — can you confirm approximate procurement lead time from your side? We have a vendor intake window the week of Oct 7 that would be ideal but open to earlier.

Also, we have a security questionnaire in flight — SOC 2 artifacts and network isolation notes would be helpful to attach.

Asha

Hi Asha / Brian — looping in Kimberly and Jonas to answer the billing and technical specifics. A few clarifications: 

- Billing: Kimberly — can you confirm the options for GCP private offer settlement? Specifically: (1) Create private offer + TerraNova pays via Marketplace settlement (standard), (2) Private offer with direct invoice to TerraNova PO (requires our finance ops to set up a billing exception and invoice the PO). We can support both, but direct invoicing will add an extra 3–5 business days to the billing setup.

- Security artifacts: Jonas, attaching a brief SOC 2 evidence pointer and network isolation guide. If it helps, we can share a scoped SOC 2 cover letter and SOC auditor contact under an NDA.

Proposed timeline (refined):
- Week 0 (kickoff): 9/17 — procurement & technical sync (30m)
- Weeks 1–2: PoC execution (engineers + Redwood SE)
- Week 3: Technical acceptance window & SRE sign-off
- Weeks 3–6: Procurement, legal redlines, DocuSign & PO issuance (earlier if procurement accelerates)

Attachments included: Redwood_DocuSign_TN_SOW.docx (draft SOW for procurement/DocuSign), Acceptance_Checklist_Redwood.pdf.

Brian / Asha — if the week-of-Oct-7 intake is your fixed deadline, we should lock on the kickoff next Tuesday to hit that window. Please confirm when you have a minute.

Thanks,
Irene
